pET-28a.description: T7-promoter expression vector with N-terminal 6xHis tag and kanamycin resistance

pUC19.description: High-copy cloning vector with lacZ MCS and ampicillin resistance

pACYC184.description: Medium-copy compatible vector (p15A ori); useful for two-plasmid systems

pCAMBIA1305.1.description: Binary vector with GUS-PLUS reporter under CaMV35S; hygromycin plant selection, kanamycin bacterial selection
pCAMBIA1305.1.notes: T-DNA contains GUS reporter + NOS terminator

pCAMBIA1300.description: Binary vector backbone without reporter; hygromycin plant selection

pBI121.description: Classic binary vector with GUS + NOS terminator under CaMV35S; kanamycin selection

pK2GW7.description: Gateway-compatible binary vector; 35S promoter, spectinomycin bacterial selection
